fields.title: Frontend Developer
fields.description: We are looking for a skilled Frontend Developer to join our team. You will be responsible for building responsive web applications using React and modern CSS frameworks.
fields.requirements:
2+ years of experience with React.js
Strong HTML/CSS skills
Experience with REST APIs
Git version control

fields.title: Backend Developer
fields.description: Join our backend team to build scalable APIs and microservices. You will work with Django and PostgreSQL to power our growing platform.
fields.requirements:
1+ years Django experience
Knowledge of REST APIs
Basic SQL knowledge

fields.title: Data Scientist
fields.description: We need an experienced Data Scientist to analyze large datasets and build ML models to improve our product recommendations.
fields.requirements:
3+ years in data science
Strong Python and ML skills
Experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch
fields.skills_required: Python, Machine Learning, TensorFlow, SQL, Pandas

fields.title: UI/UX Designer
fields.description: Looking for a creative UI/UX Designer to design beautiful and intuitive interfaces for our mobile and web applications.
fields.requirements:
Portfolio of design work
Proficiency in Figma
Understanding of user research
fields.skills_required: Figma, Adobe XD, User Research, Prototyping

fields.title: DevOps Engineer
fields.description: We are hiring a DevOps Engineer to manage our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and ensure high availability of our services.
fields.requirements:
3+ years DevOps experience
AWS or GCP certification preferred
Docker and Kubernetes experience
